The West’s and Israel’s war against Iran is having an impact on the entire world. In the Philippines, fuel prices are rising, and anti‑American and anti‑Israeli sentiment is spreading. 

Protesters clashed with police on Roxas Boulevard in Manila as they attempted to march toward the U.S. Embassy to protest what they described as arrogance and the attack on Iran.
